name: Gratification
overview: Scripture reveals that gratification rooted in fleshly desires leads to sinful acts such as adultery and fornication, which are clearly identified as works of the flesh. Jesus warns that even lustful thoughts constitute adultery in the heart, exposing the deep spiritual danger of unchecked self gratification. Believers are called to mortify earthly members by rejecting inordinate affections and evil desires, recognizing that such cravings are forms of idolatry that must be overcome through Christ-centered holiness.
